fields.name: rhythm
fields.label: Row spacing
fields.description: Framer’s two section variants. Stacked: at least 605px tall at every width; under 1024px the heading sits 16px under the hairline and the columns stack 32px apart (40 on tablets). Uniform: 10px under the hairline and 60px apart at every width, at least 605px tall on phones only (MOS Urban’s Clients, UX, Identity, Assets, Years, Outcome and What’s next).
